fields.statement: At 608fcae, go test ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/daemon -count=1 passed, and go test ./..., fmt-check and vet passed. In the kept work dir of daemon-picks.txtar, the fake Rex's rex.log shows rhiza daemon --permission-mode manual --once opened exactly one new tab (rex window new ... -c <repo> -- rhiza run start 01M5PWGQ8GB4618G4RH2TV0ZAH --permission-mode manual). That ID is the milestone change set Built's, and the line has no --autonomous; the leafless and backlog change sets got no tab. Under --once --autonomous the command ends with --permission-mode manual --autonomous. The diff of 161f5f5 (internal/api/daemon.go daemonStart) appends --autonomous only when the daemon has it, and a daemon with no mode or a bypass mode is refused before any tab opens. make self-check fails only on stale .rhiza/rendered actor/index files from the run's own model writes, not on this leaf's code.
